text: I enjoyed playing this game at first, but I have to agree with other comments & it has nothing to do with skill. It's more geared to getting you to spend in order to finish a game! I bought a package in order to complete a game, but it disappeared & I had to start it again!! Not only that, but I lost all the bonuses & had to start from scratch building them back up, which also puts you at a disadvantage when playing in the tournaments!! This happened 3times!! Support were NOT supportive! AVOID!

This is a very good game and I am genuinely addicted to this and another very similar. The one and only thing that I would class as a small downfall is the fact that you can't move the squares, for example on royal match (a very similar game) you can move the squares to make a match including the bombs, arrows and disco balls it makes the game a little more fun and slightly more challenging, other than that I am hooked. X

Great game but it's unfortunately spoilt by the developers. The first 100 levels are easy to pass and then it becomes impossible hard. Either it takes days to pass a level or you have have to purchase power up packs in the game to pass the levels. It's a shame that they try o force you into purchases as I'm sure people wouldn't mind paying a small fee to purchase the game. Feels like you're being cheated

After completing all the levels (admittedly 10000+) the Champions League is no fun at all. Deliberately hard levels with not enough moves that force you to use boosters. Run out of boosters? Spend cash to buy more! It's just pay to win at this point. Spending 4+ days trying to finish a level is not fun, and unless you spend money that's just how it will be. It's just become an endless cash grab. Sure there are plenty of freebies, but if you can't complete levels you can't earn them anyway...

This game is fun until you get up to around level 1400. Thereafter it becomes so infuriating because of the lack of skill involved in completing levels. It's more like gambling on the toss of a coin than playing a game. I can only assume it's designed like this to get you to pay for stuff to pass levels. I play games on my phone to pass the time, not empty my bank account. I just got fed up playing the same level for literally days, bye bye Toon Blast.

Saw this game advertised whilst playing a different one, but advert was not at all representative of actual gameplay (it even let's you try play a level as advertised, where you have to destroy bricks so the bear can jump down and get away from the spikes approaching from the ceiling). That wa the game I wanted to play, not just another brick breaking game. If you want a bog standard game it's entertaining enough, but the adverts should properly depict this. Too many false adverts these days.

It's a scam, the levels start off easy up and then it suddenly becomes almost impossible to pass levels without paying for power ups. I've checked my purchase history and was shocked to see I had given these scammers £150 in June alone and the same in previous months. They say it's random but I don't believe it, often you get to the end of a level and need one more move to complete it so you pay up, and at £1.99 a time it's not cheap. Nothing is free in this game, avoid it at all costs.

There was a time where I was able to win; gain the powerups and coins needed to pass levels down the line. It worked for a little while but then I had to start using the coins and powerups immediately to clear the next level. Now I cannot clear more than two levels at a time without needing coins or powerups. I might be salty but this game was never this hard to beat, after this new season is over I'll probably delete it. Also after the TOS update I will never play again.

I ran a successful team with my partner, we tried to keep our team motivated through all the changes. Contacting support was a pointless exercise they seem to go out of their way to misinterpret everything you say. I am not stupid, it is blatantly obvious that a player who was getting the option to watch adverts for moves has a distinct advantage over players who didn't. Not so said support. I now find I'm no longer leader of my own team, because I haven't played enough apparently.

As many many other reviewers have said , this game was absolutely brilliant , but these last 6 months or so the dynamic has changed. Now it is merely a cash cow to generate as much money from the players as possible. Levels are nigh on impossible without purchases . When once you got 150 coins for a relatively small fee , you now get only 100 coins for a larger fee, so when originally every 2nd purchase you kinda got free lives , that's all gone . Time to find summat else to play me thinks

At the beginning it feels very controlled and boring ... But hang in there as it does eventually take off! In my opinion it's just as addictive as Candy Crush ... But you have to be very determined to make it through some of the levels, as it does feel like you need to make a purchase to get through ... But you do ... Eventually!!!

Used to be a real good game. I used to watch 3 ads to get my 5 extra lives but now the 3rd add don't work and so I am left with only 3 extra moves. Sometimes it allows me to have adds and sometimes I got to pay with my gold. Also it has got alot harder. Collect the ducks, break the box, get the snow globs and collect the bubbles with only 20 moves . How? Its just got ridiculous now. As I said Used to live the game now it takes a good 30 minutes to actually do 1 level. Sort it out

Please DO NOT sped money on this game! It is rigged and unfair. I had played the game for 3 years. Recently some of my friend and teamates got a feature where you can watch an ad to clear a level. I and lots of other people didn't get the feature so it's not a fair competition. I have to spend real money if I want to compete with other players who don't. I contacted the developers who acknowledged it wasn't fair and agreed to refund me for my purchases. Then changed there mind. Google refunded .

I'm quite disappointed what has been going on lately. They've been adding new levels that are impossible to pass with moves given. They've also taken away the additional moves that you were able to get after seeing ads. It was relaxing, but now I feel like they are trying to force one to buy coins, passes, and things to make some of the levels possible to pass. It's getting boring that way. Level 9201 BTW. I'm thinking of stopping playing as what is supposed to be relaxing is now stressful.

Been playing for years, and it used to be a fun game. Now I have to agree with others saying it's just become focused on trying to get players to spend money. Now ending up stuck on 'normal difficulty' levels for days on end, with the option of watching ads for extra moves gone. It makes playing the extra tournaments pointless. It's now just a game I pop on to every now and then and close to deleting. Now even worse march 24, reflecting in team too. Down to 1 star

I actually used to enjoy this game and would have rated far higher, but I have noticed that in recent updates so much has been changed that no longer rewards the player as much. In the rally first and second place used to get gold, now you get infinite lives for fifteen minutes in second. The trail rewards thing used to start free, now you pay 6.99 to start it? Money grabbing rubbish now I'm afraid. Such a shame as I got so far with it, but I think I'm going to uninstall and find something else.

Disappointed! I've played this game for over 5 years & reached lv 10,300+ Always played with the double disco ball, then one day I lose it. Bought a bundle to help get it back, but lose it 3 more times in quick succession. This has never happened before. Cheap bundles used to be £1-3, now £5-7 I will NEVER play this game again due to the money grab Constant ads in other games begging me to return What was once a beautiful relaxing game, ruined once again by greedy devs!

I like it, I played it a year ago👍 I worked my way through over 10,000 levels, but then couldn't get anywhere unless I spent loads of money on boosters, I would do very well, get a load of coins saved up, only to get impossible levels and had to lose them, it is a very nice game. I uninstalled and started all over again, knowing how the game work's.

I've played about 15 levels and you can tell how bad this is a fixed game. Its a pay to play game. You will get past say 50 - 100 levels to get you addicted then start making it difficult for you, so you pay for lives. They have put random directional rockets in the game. Random in a game is fixing! Make a game that's fun, not one that you have to pay constantly. Charge 79p for a good game that's fun with no further charges.

It says the arrows are at random but when you get the same arrow 10x in a row it says to me it's fixed so you spend money to get another X5 moves on the level. I've been playing for a couple of years now but it's all turned money orientated ( not cheap either). If you are only just downloading the game I would say don't bother unless you have money to burn and don't mind been stuck on a level for a week 🫠👍

Really really good addicting game, but had to leave a review cause game has totally crashed... wouldn't connect to the internet so closed it down, now when trying to access it cannot click on anything. Can't play, can't see how far in a challenge you are, can't access settings, basically nothing is clickable. When you close the app down the music continues playing on phone in the background until phone is restarted. Help?

I used to really enjoy this game and would go between this and Fishdom, BUT, as many others have said it becomes so repetitive when you get to the higher levels. I've been stuck on my current level (1061) for days on end. I've used the boosters but to no avail. I get that it's a business and they want players buying resources with real money (which I'll never do!) but there's got to be a balance. Also, I agree that there should be better rewards and the chance for infinite lives occasionally too

I've been playing this game for a long time. It's one that is just annoyingly addictive! I've updated and taken stars away. The game seems to get impossible at times, literally with no way of winning. When you're stuck for 2 days, it isn't fun anymore. They also seem to want money constantly, which I now refuse to spend on. I will quit if these issues persist. It isn't enjoyable at the moment.

I am now at level 215 and I have concluded that there is nothing random about this game at all. It's completely fixed... It's designed to get you so far and then all the coins and extras you have worked for vanish to get out of the statistically impossible levels forcing you to buy more. The waiting for lives things is stupid . All the user does is leave the game that seems daft to me as you want to keep the user on the game as long as possible... The colour generator is statistically impossible as it knows your waiting for one colour and you use up all your moves waiting on it. The rocket things are random but always seem to be facing away from where you need them. Complete cheat and waste of time. Why spoil a great game by doing this? Still stuck... I worked out the probabilities for this level it's impossible without purchasing add-ons... Peak games is ripping you off, it's a shame was such a good game too...

You win when the game wants you to win. It doesn't matter how well you play because more often than not the game will block you from passing a level by constantly dropping the wrong block, usually on the last move to irritate you. I assume this is how they entice people to pay for extra moves. I wouldn't even bother buying extra moves, it will only get you past that particular level then the next level you will be presented with the same issue. Toy Blast is the same.

It started off okay.... then the levels suddenly became unbelievably difficult... to the point where you are expected to spend money to pass, or be incredibly lucky every single time with special moves etc. It took all the fun out of it when it took days to be lucky enough to complete a level or you just fall for the scam and buy extra moves which are obviously needed. It's just not fun anymore, deleting. Oh and the cheaper option on extra moves dissappears the second time so you spend more.

The extra star is for customer service because whenever I have reached out, they promptly get back to me. I have been playing this game for a few years now and whenever I've bought a new device, it's the first gaming app I've installed. Unfortunately I have to agree with the other negative reviews. It is becoming increasingly impossible to some levels without making in-app purchases. Yes, you can carry on playing until you pass the level but I have tried for a solid 3 days before moving on.

Great game. Rather addictive..... Edit: I hate the new rewards system they introduced. Purely changed to try and make people spend real money in the game. They have taken the fun out of the weekly team games as well because lots of members of our team have lost interest and just arent playing, because of the changes. Im finding the game crashes much more frequently now to. Im not angry, just completely disappointed.

I have been playing this game for a very long time, and used to love it, but the latest update has ruined it. Without constantly paying for coins, it can take weeks to gain enough to get 5 extra moves. The more people you used to help with extra lives, and the more levels you won, used to give you enough moves to make the game fun. Team chest was great, but the rewards from that as well are pathetic now

I did originally give it 5 stars but I've reduced it because their are a few things I don't like. I'm happy with the game play itself, but further in and lots of ads. Some of the levels are so hard and you just don't get enough goes to get through them so you waist your 5 lives pretty quick, and you have to wait hours for them to fill up again so designed to make you purchase more if you haven't been awarded extra. Battle through and 'eventually' you'll get through a hard level by pure luck.

The game is becoming awful. When getting to the champions league, it's impossible without spending coins/money. I've been stuck on the same level for 4 days and refuse to spend money to pass it. I've reported it to the support team to be told it's possible to pass the level. I'm sorry but taking 4+ days becomes a bore. Its not enjoyable or entertaining. Sort it out toon blast team. It's a joke

All about money now unfortunately. No adverts and the game is good, but it's being made increasingly hard with no better reward, there's quite a few levels where you have to pay to get through or you'll be stuck for weeks. Side games in it are also being made increasingly hard and the reward is the same. Disappointed but will be uninstalling

What on earth have you done ? The new reward system is a disaster ! My entire team hate it. You cannot even bank the rewards to use later when you can play more. I gave this 5 stars originally now all I want is the delete app button and I have been playing over 3 years, great way to reward your loyal customers. And don't give me the standard thanks for helping us make this game better reply. If you want to make it better go back to the old reward system !!

Disgusting 🤢. If you don't want to spend money, don't play it. The progress needs money. Before to delete it I wish to the developer to play Toon Blast as they designed it, for all the eternity, to feel the stress and the frustration that they give us with all their "easy" levels that in reality are impossible to pass. Starting with 4700, if you don't pay 18 pounds monthly plus 10 pounds for the pass, you get stucked on an easy level for ages. Both middle fingers up!

This was a great game. Easy to get through the levels until I got to the 660's levels where it became tougher. They kindly let me begin again after being stuck for days on the one level! Now I have found it really hard to get through the two hundreds! I am now stuck for so long that I am getting bored! If they don't go back to the original game I will be leaving. Come on developers be fair or you will lose a lot of bored people!

It was a great game until now. There have been changes in game play and you no longer get chests with power ups for collecting stars and completing 10 levels. Now it's almost impossible to get power ups meaning it's no longer fun to play as some of the levels are passable by using power ups. I'm uninstalling after getting to level 4200. An indication of how good the game WAS.

I'm only on level 11, but so far this game is just a match 3. No ads thus far, which is great, but I've not been playing long, maybe only 20 minutes. My biggest complaint about this game is that it limits the number of moves you can play, and the limit becomes VERY limiting VERY quickly. None of the game's extra features have been unlocked yet (I think the trading cards unlock at lvl 70), and I'm not sure that I'll be able to get there. If I have to replay a lvl more than 10 times, I quit.

Frustrated. After completing thousands of levels I'm thinking that i'll have to uninstall what had been a fantastic game because the ability to gain extra free moves by watching a few adverts in return has been removed. Now I'm stuck on most levels for days on end with zero hope of being offered much needed extra moves. Totally disappeared a couple of weeks ago. The game is no longer enjoyable. Please put back in the adverts for free moves. Lifeline if stuck on a level. pleaseeeeee.

Love the game its very addictive, but since getting a new device i have had trouble moving my progress over. Have been in contact a few times from both devices but so far have not managed to sort it. My original query was responded to promptly however it went to my old device and as i did not reply within 24 hours they closed the conversation so i had to start again. Apart from this a great experience, just want to sync my progress so i can fully appreciate the game again!

I've played this game on and off for years and it's been a lifesaver for me during night feeds, but it's so much harder to get coins since the update. I'm glad I stockpiled some before the game changed otherwise I would be screwed. Also the chest prize of 60 mins unlimited lives is stupid as you have to use it when you open the chest even if you don't want to!

After playing and enjoying this game for several years, I've decided to uninstall it. The recent update has made the game ridiculously difficult, and often it can take more than a day just to complete one level. If the changes were reversed, I might consider reinstalling, but at the moment, the game just isn't fun anymore. Looking on the Toon Blast Facebook page and the reviews on here, I can see that I'm not the only one who feels this way.

I use to love this game. I played it for a long time but then they just put an update on the has made the levels suddenly more difficult and they have taken away ways to win in game money which helps with boosters and now its a money grabbing game where you have to pay real money to pass levels. Not happy at all. I uninstalled it.

It's a good little game. But the time zones are how teams lose. And individuals tend to not give lives. Plus the company tends to persuade us to spend our hard earned cash. Try as we may to win each level is very hard. So the makers of the game tend to offer silly offers so we can get on or merry way. I tend not to purchase and tend to play another games what's free. But that's my opinion. Enjoy until you need lives

I absolutely used to love this game and while I still play the recent update is utter trash and I won't be spending any money on extra out of principal. Please revert this update, it's just awful! Free lives are great, but the fact you can't save them for another time and need to use them and then is not convenient. The coins you win for completing challenges are now non existent and I wouldn't recommend this game to anyone now.

Started off promising but got to the usual stage where it is almost impossible to get past a level. Using up bonus items doesn't make a difference. Sadly this is just like some other games I've come across. Start easy to reel you in then get you stuck and push you to buy packs. Three stars is generous due to fun element. But now uninstalling due to pushy sales.

I have had the game 3 years, my mission was to complete it but everytime you get so far another 500 episodes are added on. Now with the updates near impossible to enjoy it as the levels are harder with hardly any coins i have decided to quit it, especially because the teams i am in keep throwing me out when i am getting between 50-100 stars per week, i was polite, helped as much as i could but still thrown from teams. I just wanted to complete a fun (was) game not be competetive with anyone.

I used to love this game but the latest system for the free boosts and the level difficulty (it's fixed, playing each level dozens of times then suddenly beating it with 5 moves left!) make it impossible to earn coins, increases frustration and is ultimately aimed at making us spend real money :( The lack of adds is the games saving grace.

This WAS a good a game. The upgrade Increased the prices, took down the rewards and even shaved 5 mins off the extra time you obtain!! It feels very money grabbing. Levels aren't just hard or super hard now they are 'impossible'. Toonpass was reasonable at 4.99 but this is now double the price. Such a shame. Will be deleting after a good year or more on this game

Used to love this game. But now it's become pay to play. Considering the amount of money I have given this game in the past year, willingly, it frustrated me that now we get an hour of free lives (after when it would have helped). I personally feel the coins that we got from the challenges were worth coming onto the game. They helped pass those "difficult" levels. Now I'm conflicted on if I want to keep this game. Only reason I would keep it, is for my team. If you're new, don't bother.

Seriously thinking of deleting this game. I've been playing it for around 3 years and it can be fun as well as frustrating. All levels are passable, but so often the blocks mysteriously don't fall right. But that's ok. What isn't ok is the latest update has taken away almost all chances of gaining coins without spending real world money. The free rewards have all but vanished in game play.Peak need to seriously look at the damage the update is doing to players fun before they start leave en mass

Level 27 so far. I'm waiting for the catch. It's free and no adverts. Update: it's a couple of years later. I'm still playing. Level 7101. Found a clan I'm happy with. Still no adverts, but sometime the urge is strong tonourchase in-app boosters, or just hold on and jeep trying to clear a level with the daily gift boosters. You don't have to pay to play, but it js an option.

After 6400+ levels and years of enjoyable and occasional frustrating play I'm done, too many attempts to take your hard earned cash, now luck is just needed to complete levels, little or no skill, just the algorithm allowing knowledgeable players to progress really easily or simply not at all, off to find my next "fun go to place"...its been a blast, no pun intended, the game is great for newcomers so dont let my review put you off

Ok for a while but rapidly gets boring. Another match game with the same predictable practices as others - rockets always travel the opposite way to that you need, etc. Rounds get stupidly difficult after a while but you will magically pass them when the software decides to let you, or presumably you pay to. Uninstalled today. Will find something else.....

Update Oct24 - This game is starting to feel as hard as life. Where have the adverts gone for free moves? Surely they generate income for you? I don't know if you have different people working on it, but it's definitely not as enjoyable as it used to be. It just feels like everything is a struggle. I recommend this game to everyone! It's fantastic! Full of prizes, mini games and no adverts, unless you choose to watch for free lives. Love it! Well done and big thanks to the creators 👏💜

Used to be an enjoyable game but recent updates make it virtually impossible to win levels without using anvils, boxing gloves or hammers which are hard to collect now that chests for stars and levels have been taken away! Update: What a trite response from the developer! They haven't got the message yet from all the 1 star reviews! I used to occasionally win Cooper's Rally and Star Tournaments, but get stuck on a level even with an hour of unlimited lives! Won't be playing any more!

I like the game, it's very engaging and a pleasant way to spend a bit of time. But it uses a lot of power. I noticed my Motorola G5 was getting hot when I played. Unfortunately, by that time the battery had overheated, it was swollen and damaged and I had to replace it. Maybe this game needs a more powerful phone. 5 stars because I like the game. 1 star because it destroyed my phone's battery. Average of those two = 3 stars. :-)

as much as I enjoyed it first I'm not on level 466 which I got to quite easily but as soon as I got to level 365 I've noticed it throws out blocks everywhere you don't need them after like 33 goes on level 365 I had to buy add ons to get past it and now it's the same with level 466 and the jelly things spread to fast that you get one match whilst 5 more jellies appear so you've got triple the amount of jellies to move and not enough space to be able to make any special moves together.

Such a shame with the new update that the enjoyment has gone. The amazing rewards and challenge opportunities have been key to what made this game enjoyable and helped to progress even when stuck on a level for a few days. Without these incentives after 4 years and being over level 4000 I am close to deleting. Previously I have spent money on new coins to top up but now I feel we are being forced to I am very much agaisnt buying them!!

Didn't expect to enjoy this so much. Gave it a try after seeing many many adverts for it. They do not do it justice. The first 300 levels were easy peasy, I'm past 1000 now and it's much harder. it's one of the only games that doesn't have ads, but i can totally imagine people paying for the in game currency so they clearly don't need it

Since I wrote my review, things in the game have changed for the worst. Please undo the changes you made to it recently, its made playing the game very frustrating, and turned it into a chore to play it. Please also reinstall the 50000 coins for winning the tournament, as 25000 feels like a slap in the face.

This game is amazing. I'm addicted to it because I always wanted to be number 1 even with my teammates lol I know sometimes it can be tough but that's part of the fun you don't need to purchase anything if you don't want to it's all up to you. And no Ads too unlike the other games ads keeps popping. Thank you for this game ❤️

do me a favour and stop sending me ads to come back and redownload your game, it's very annoying. when I had the game and played it for 8 years I was not appreciated. I sent you three messages during my time asking for videos for extra moves but you told me that it's not possible and no one cared, you put levels that are impossible to beat so that we pay money (big rip off), but I'm not paying a penny + I deleted the game + I convinced others to do so as well. No stress! there are better games!

I've been playing since may 2018 I'm in champ mode the lasted milestone & I've even got a new tablet so it doesn't boot me off anymore. the adverts are the problem because they won't play even when they are visible. HOW ABOUT GETTING RID OF THE ANNOYING ADVERTS THAT WON'T OPEN!!!AND SWAP THEM FOR 5 MOVES. I was playing the hour, but I gave up because I'm stuck & fed up with the adverts not working properly. until it's fixed 1☆. I've have messaged in the game. please help.

Really, you now have to collect 1000 stars in the challenge! It is getting ridiculous to complete levels. I did enjoy the game, not so much anymore. We would win money after a challenge and not 60 min to play. It would be fine if you could pause the game but you can not, you don't always have time to sit for an hour.

I have played this game as a destress for a long time. Recently the rewards system has changed and you "earn" a lot less for completing challenges. That coupled with this new reward that will only unlock the next reward if you pay for the current reward (£2.49 for coins). Has ruined the game for me, I would have paid for the app itself but you have sold your soul for forced in game purchases peak, not cool.

After reading the 1⭐ reviews I felt I needed to share my experience. i'm addicted 🤣. If you love puzzles you'll love this It's awesome, lots of different puzzles some very challenging, lots of rewards to help you out. If you get stuck on a level don't throw a tantrum, leave a bad review or delete the app, just keep playing. Puzzles would be boring if they didn't switch it up a bit. And it's so much more gratifying when you complete a very hard level. Oh and sorry no spikes 🤔 (check out the ad)

This used to be a fun game but now it's beyond a joke when it's taken over 50 goes to get past one level , when you select boosters at the start of a level they never end up together , hard level & super hard level never give you enough moves , like other people I will not pay for coins to get through the next level, like most games it is fixed so you have to buy stuff , again , greedy app developers who more interested in lining their pockets

Started to enjoy this then read some reviews. Looks like the levels showed before we download it are never going to be made available. Just what royal kingdom does. No saving lives! ONE BIG CON. Levels which are not in the game play, should NOT be allowed to be shown in the ads to make it look more exciting! I checked out level 7000 on you tube, and yup!.... Still destroying blocks. Just a boring version of candy crush! Uninstalling

The people who say you have to pay to get anywhere isn't true. I've been playing for over a year I do play every day, I'm on a great team and at the min I'm on level 4001 and onto the championship Cup until New levels come on every 2 weeks. I haven't spent a penny some levels are hard but there is a knack to finishing them you just have to find it.

Recently, some levels have got really hard, to be the point that there is no skill in completing them, only luck (e.g. getting three disco balls in short succession). I get that you need to make money, but making us frustrated into paying to get past a level by buying extra goes etc, means the game stops being fun. And as they say in gambling, when the fun stops, stop.

Game is fun and frustrating. I have completed over 9000 levels, but be warned ⚠️ DO NOT BUY ANY PACKAGES ⚠️ as soon as you do any free options to get lives etc by watching adds are Gone. After paying for something all the options to get extras you WILL NEED sometimes you will have to pat for. All levels are winnable, you might have to do them a few times to get past them....

Very addictive game. Later on some screens are almost impossible and it takes days to get through (unless you pay for weapons!). It would be nice to have the option to start again. EDIT - 5th Jan 2024 - Downgraded to 2 stars. Too many adverts are now 60 seconds each. Even worse, some do not format properly on my Samsung S10+ meaning you lose your weapons and bonuses. Has made the game very frustrating to play now. If it continues I will uninstall.

I just love this game! It has all the cartoon characters you'd come to expect in a game w this title: Popeye, The Flintstones, Tom & Jerry, Woody Woodpecker, Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, The Jetsons, Yogi Bear, Mickey Mouse, Yosemite Sam, The Roadrunner, and so on and so on. They're all here!!! Trouble is, they're not. We have to put up w generic characters probably bc the devs couldn't afford the real thing? Great! Worse, the game itself is just another run of the mill derivative of so many others.

I love playing this game but once you buy into purchasing that add-ons it kind of goes in a cycle where you get addicted to doing so. It's your offer freebies more often and not bias the game or cheat to get you to keep purchasing.

Really upset right now. I play all day every day and then my phone updated and suddenly I got a free 5 lives, didn't recieve. Got booted and now I cannot get back in. Have cleared data and cache. Have Uninstalled and reinstalled. No luck. Please fix asap and credit me back for the prizes lost

Thank you for updating the price of the in game purchases - I was spending far too much time (and money) on this game, the chunky increase is what I needed to wean me off this stupid never ending game to go and do something more useful.

Love this game. I only have one suggestion,to carry over leftover moves from one level to the next. Some levels have way too little moves to complete the goal but then others you finish and have 13 moves left

New update!! Well...... You are now forcing us to watch your adverts! You can't press X to start again, you have to watch that first ad. I know and understand this means more revenue for you BUT!! I don't like being played, pardon the pun. Please give us a chance to choose if this is the route you wish go down. Update ASAP please.

It's really fun and definitely addictive. The only real complaint I have is when you earn "unlimited life" for x amount time you have to use it right then.
